overview: The Marathon County Board held a special meeting that included a closed session, after which supervisors voted unanimously to refer to the executive committee the formation of a response to Aligning Energy, development of a legal strategy, and to solicit input from Farmland First and Wisconsinites for Local Control. The board also directed administration to obtain outside legal counsel to potentially represent the county in negotiations and intervention in the Public Service Commission process, signaling significant county opposition to a wind or energy development project.

discussions.item: Motion regarding Aligning Energy and legal strategy
discussions.body: Following closed session, a supervisor identified in the transcript as 'Supervisor Clli' (name unclear in transcript) made a motion to refer to the executive committee the formation of a response to Aligning Energy and development of a legal strategy, with direction to solicit input from Farmland First and Wisconsinites for Local Control. The motion also directed administration to obtain outside legal counsel to represent the county in negotiations and potential intervention in the Public Service Commission process. The motion was seconded and passed unanimously on a roll call vote.
Board Chair Kurt Gibbs called for announcements or requests. None were offered by board members.
A motion to adjourn was made by Supervisor Watson and seconded by Supervisor Mash. The motion carried on a voice vote with no opposition.
